title: Quirky Citrusy Greek Guanciale Dolmades
description: A kid-friendly Greek dish featuring guanciale, this recipe is a twist on traditional dolmades with a citrusy and snappy flavor, making it a great flexitarian option. The dish is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, diced guanciale, chopped scallions, lemon juice, orange juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you, and place about 1 tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package, and repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Place the dolmades in a single layer in a baking dish, seam-side down, and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the dolmades warm, garnished with additional lemon juice and scallions if desired.
Let the dolmades cool completely on a wire rack before refrigerating or freezing them.
